findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/events.js::commitmint copy loop has no error handling after the prior anchor is removed
findings.title: commitMint copy loop has no error handling after the prior anchor is removed
findings.action: None required; optionally a follow-up to catch IO errors in the copy loop and print an errno-only refusal line.
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec step 8 and the edge case 'Crash during commitMint' accept a partial --dest (prior anchor survives in git, next Step 9b re-mints, CI fails a partial anchor); 'a refused mint writes nothing' governs refusals, not IO faults during commit; the pre-change mint had no handling either.

occurrences.title: commitMint copy loop has no error handling after the prior anchor is removed
